Ancient Egypt had... interesting ideas about birth control 🐊

The Kahun papyrus, written around 1825 BC, lists crocodile dung as a contraceptive. Historians still argue about how it was used, and there is no evidence it worked.

Today condoms are up to 98% effective when used correctly, and they also help protect against STIs.

Sources: Kahun Gynaecological Papyrus, NHS.
